scenes.narration: Can you guess who buys all the treadmills at Planet Fitness?
Many clubs are run by franchise owners. They buy their machines from Planet Fitness itself.
In 2025, that equipment business brought in 310 million dollars, up 21 percent.
Next to franchise fees and its own clubs, that's a big slice of 1.3 billion dollars.
It all runs on 20.8 million members in nearly 2,900 clubs.
Members pay monthly. Owners buy the machines.
